title: eCPRI over Ethernet node: 64-byte Ethernet frames with FCS, address and Ethertype filter, eCPRI IQ data into a 32-word buffer with seq_id gap tracking, generic memory transfer against a 64 x 32-bit memory, remote reset, event indication with fault / sync acks, and CPU fault injection

words.name: DMAC_LO
words.desc: peer MAC [31:0] (DMAC of transmitted frames); reset 0xCCDDEEFF

words.name: SMAC_LO
words.desc: own MAC [31:0] (SMAC of transmitted frames, RX address filter); reset 0x33445566

words.name: IQ
words.desc: IQ buffer head (32 x 32-bit, big-endian packed IQ bytes); the read pops it

words.name: COUNTS
words.desc: {rx error count[7:0], rx ok count[7:0], seq_id gap count[7:0], 2'b0, IQ words[5:0]}

words.name: IQ_LAST
words.desc: {pc_id[15:0], seq_id[15:0]} of the last IQ message

words.name: EVENT
words.desc: write: inject a fault indication {raise[20], fault number[19:8], event_id[7:0]}; read: last recorded event {8'h0, seq[7:0], 5'h0, type[2:0], event_id[7:0]}

words.name: ERRORS
words.desc: {concat, overflow, malformed, msgtype, fcs} error flags (sticky, write 1 to clear; a new error in the same clock wins)

words.name: RESET_OP
words.desc: [15:0] reset_id of the last remote reset request (also the reset_op pin); write bit 0 = 1 to clear

words.name: RX_SMAC_LO
words.desc: source MAC [31:0] of the last accepted message

words.name: RX_SMAC_HI
words.desc: [15:0] source MAC [47:32] of the last accepted message

words.name: TX_STATUS
words.desc: {14'h0, ack_wait, injection pending, tx seq[7:0], 5'h0, TX queue count[2:0]}

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: any ERRORS flag is set (FCS, msgtype, malformed message, IQ buffer / TX queue overflow, concatenation); held until ERRORS is cleared, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: rx_d / rx_dv (received frame bytes), tx_d / tx_en (transmitted frame bytes) and reset_op pass through unchanged. Preamble, SFD and IFG belong to the external MAC.
The core's CPU port is mapped one word per register; a write with PSTRB != 4'hF to a writable word is dropped with PSLVERR.
